newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu promises to push ahead with Hebron deal.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu promises to push ahead with Hebron deal.

text.p: Israeli leader Benjamin Netanyahu condemned a soldier's shooting of Palestinians on Wednesday in a call to Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat and vowed to implement their peace deals, an aide to Arafat said.

"Mr Netanyahu called Arafat and condemned the crime. He said this will not prevent him from pursuing the peace process and implementing the peace deals," Arafat's adviser Nabil Abu Rdainah told Reuters.
"The peace talks will continue later today. The talks were delayed for a few hours but were not suspended," he said.
Israeli-PLO negotiations scheduled for noon (1000 GMT) would be delayed for a few hours but not suspended, he said.
